description.p: Alex vs Bus: The Race is a free and open source platform runner game in which Alex is just a man who depends on public transportation in a developing country and needs to run in order to catch the bus, or else he will have to wait an eternity for the next bus to come.

ul.li: A finished game, complete with 13 levels across 3 different difficulties and an ending sequence.
Audio and visual style inspired by the 8-bit era, although the game is not bound to all of the technical limitations of the period.
Keyboard and gamepad supported as input devices.
A different cutscene when clearing each level.
